name: Tokyo, Hakone + Kyoto, Japan
tagline: Neon Tokyo, Fuji views, temple Kyoto
whyParents: Spotless, safe, superb food and trains; Tokyo winter light displays feel like a Paris Christmas.

costPP.flightsBasis: Estimate. JAL site showed NYC-Tokyo economy ~$1,837 (Nov 10 to Dec 9 dates); Cheapflights Dec average ~$1,192 (data from Mar 2026). Mid-Dec AA/JAL nonstop typically $1,200 to $1,600.
costPP.lodgingBasis: Tokyo 3BR apartment ~$250/night x3, Hakone ryokan 2 rooms ~$500 x1, Kyoto machiya ~$250/night x2; ~$1,750 total split 4 ways
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$60/day food and sights x7, plus ~$130 Tokyo-Hakone-Kyoto trains (Shinkansen)

flight.routing: JFK-HND nonstop (AA167, Boeing 787-9, reviewed flying Sept 2026); return Haneda-JFK same day
flight.notes: JAL (oneworld, AA joint venture) also flies JFK-HND nonstop. No Asia nonstops from PHL: connect via JFK or DFW (AA DFW-HND daily from Oct 25 2026). Lose ~1 day each way to travel and date line.

weather.precip: dry and sunny, rain ~5 days/month, snow rare in Tokyo/Kyoto

stay: Tokyo: Ginza/Tokyo Station area, walk to Marunouchi lights. Kyoto: Gion, temples on foot.
getAround: Metro and JR trains; Shinkansen Tokyo-Kyoto ~2h15m. Ship big bags ahead by takkyubin. No car needed.
entry: Visa-free up to 90 days. JESTA e-authorization not until fiscal 2028. Passport valid for stay.
events: Marunouchi Illumination: 2025 season ran Nov 13 to Feb 15 (free); 2026 dates not yet confirmed
Roppongi Hills Keyakizaka Illumination: 2025 ran Nov 4 to Dec 25, 5 to 11pm (free); 2026 dates not yet confirmed
Tokyo Midtown Christmas lights: 2025 ran Nov 13 to Dec 25; 2026 not yet confirmed
pros: Very safe, easy trains, amazing food
Winter illuminations and clear Fuji views
cons: Two of seven days lost to flying

itinerary.title: Land Haneda, Shibuya lights
itinerary.plan: Leave JFK Dec 12, land Haneda Dec 13 afternoon. Check in, evening stroll Shibuya crossing.

itinerary.title: Asakusa + Marunouchi lights
itinerary.plan: Senso-ji temple and Nakamise street, Sumida river walk, dusk at Marunouchi illuminations.

itinerary.title: Meiji Shrine + Roppongi
itinerary.plan: Meiji Shrine, Harajuku, Shibuya Sky view, evening Roppongi Keyakizaka lights with Tokyo Tower.

itinerary.title: Hakone loop + onsen
itinerary.plan: Romancecar to Hakone, ropeway over Owakudani, Lake Ashi boat, Fuji views, overnight ryokan.

itinerary.title: Shinkansen to Kyoto
itinerary.plan: Bullet train from Odawara to Kyoto. Afternoon Fushimi Inari torii trail, fewer crowds late.

itinerary.title: Arashiyama + Golden Pavilion
itinerary.plan: Early Arashiyama bamboo grove, Tenryu-ji garden, then Kinkaku-ji. Evening Gion lanes.

itinerary.title: Train to Tokyo, fly home
itinerary.plan: Morning Shinkansen to Tokyo (Fuji on right side), Haneda evening flight, land JFK same day.
itinerary.eat: Ekiben bento box on the train

name: Bangkok + Chiang Mai, Thailand
tagline: Golden temples, street food, cool northern hills
whyParents: The Thailand they are curious about: grand palaces, gentle elephants, warm dry weather, very low costs.

costPP.flightsBasis: Estimate. JAL site showed NYC-Bangkok $1,297 (Dec 6 to Jan 14); EVA $1,375 (Jan). Mid-Dec ~$1,300 plus ~$50 BKK-CNX domestic.
costPP.lodgingBasis: Bangkok 3BR condo ~$120/night x3, Chiang Mai 3BR house ~$90/night x3; ~$630 total split 4 ways

flight.routing: JFK-HND-BKK on JAL, AA codeshare; or Cathay JFK-HKG-BKK; or Qatar JFK-DOH-BKK
flight.notes: No AA metal to Thailand. Cathay (Asia Miles) and Qatar (via BA Avios) are Capital One transfer options. BKK-CNX ~1h10m on Thai/AirAsia.

weather.precip: dry season, rain ~1 to 2 days/month; Chiang Mai nights ~60F

stay: Bangkok: Riverside/Silom, boats to temples. Chiang Mai: Old City, walk everywhere.
getAround: BTS Skytrain, river boats, Grab cars (book XL for 4 + bags). Fly BKK-Chiang Mai. No self-drive needed.
entry: Visa-free 30 days (cut from 60 on Sept 15 2026). Free TDAC online within 3 days before arrival.
events: No specific festival verified for Dec 12 to 18 2026; peak dry, cool season
Chiang Mai Night Bazaar runs nightly
pros: Lowest daily costs of any option
cons: No AA nonstop; partner airlines only

itinerary.title: Land Bangkok, river dusk
itinerary.plan: Leave Dec 12, land Dec 13. Check in, sunset river boat past Wat Arun.

itinerary.title: Grand Palace + Wat Pho
itinerary.plan: Early Grand Palace and Emerald Buddha (cover shoulders, knees), Wat Pho, ferry to Wat Arun.
itinerary.eat: Tom yum goong at Krua Apsorn

itinerary.title: Floating market + Chinatown
itinerary.plan: Morning Damnoen Saduak floating market by car, evening Yaowarat Chinatown street food.
itinerary.eat: Crispy pork and fish maw soup on Yaowarat

itinerary.title: Fly to Chiang Mai
itinerary.plan: Morning flight north. Old City temples: Wat Chedi Luang and Wat Phra Singh.
itinerary.eat: Khao soi at Khao Soi Khun Yai

itinerary.title: Doi Suthep views
itinerary.plan: Grab up to Doi Suthep temple, city views, then Nimman cafes and a Thai massage.

itinerary.title: Elephants + Night Bazaar
itinerary.plan: Ethical no-riding elephant sanctuary half day, evening Night Bazaar shopping.
itinerary.eat: Mango sticky rice at the bazaar

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.plan: Morning temple walk, fly CNX-BKK or via Tokyo; land NYC Dec 19 same day.

name: Singapore
tagline: Garden city, hawker feasts, tropical Christmas
whyParents: Spotless, safe, English-speaking; Christmas lights at Gardens by the Bay and Orchard Road in tropical warmth.

costPP.flightsBasis: Estimate. Air Canada page showed JFK-SIN $1,244 (Dec 29 to Jan 12); SQ EWR-SIN showed $2,628 (Dec 22 holiday dates) and $1,453 (late Oct). Mid-Dec one-stop ~$1,300; SQ nonstop likely $1,500+.
costPP.lodgingBasis: 2 hotel rooms ~$230/night each x6 nights (~$2,800) split 4 ways; private short-term rentals restricted in Singapore
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$60/day: cheap hawker meals, but Gardens domes, Sentosa, Wonderland tickets add up

flight.routing: JFK-HND-SIN on JAL (AA codeshare) or JFK-HKG-SIN on Cathay, 1 stop. Singapore Airlines JFK/EWR-SIN nonstops have no economy cabin (premium economy and business only)
flight.notes: Longest flights in the world. oneworld alt: JAL JFK-HND-SIN or Cathay JFK-HKG-SIN (~24h). KrisFlyer and Asia Miles are Capital One transfer partners.

weather.precip: monsoon season: short heavy showers most afternoons, ~19 rain days/month

stay: Marina Bay or Clarke Quay, walk to Gardens and river.
getAround: MRT trains and buses everywhere; Grab cars cheap for 4. No car needed.
entry: Visa-free up to 90 days. Free SG Arrival Card online within 3 days before arrival.
events: Christmas Wonderland, Gardens by the Bay: 2025 ran Nov 29 to Jan 1, 5:30 to 11pm; 2026 dates not yet announced
Orchard Road Christmas on A Great Street: 2025 lit Nov 8 to Jan 1; 2026 dates not yet announced
pros: Hawker food is cheap and excellent

itinerary.title: Land Dec 14, Marina Bay
itinerary.plan: Leave JFK Dec 12, land Dec 14 early. Nap, evening Spectra light show at Marina Bay.
itinerary.eat: Satay at Lau Pa Sat's Satay Street

itinerary.title: Gardens + Christmas Wonderland
itinerary.plan: Supertree Grove skywalk, Garden Rhapsody light show, then Christmas Wonderland.

itinerary.title: Cloud Forest + Flower Dome
itinerary.plan: Cool off in Cloud Forest waterfall dome and Flower Dome, then riverside Clarke Quay.
itinerary.eat: Hainanese chicken rice at Tian Tian, Maxwell

itinerary.title: Chinatown + Little India
itinerary.plan: Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, Chinatown shophouses, then colorful Little India and Kampong Glam.

itinerary.title: Sentosa island
itinerary.plan: Cable car to Sentosa, S.E.A. Aquarium, beach time at Siloso, sunset drinks.

itinerary.title: Botanic Gardens + Orchard
itinerary.plan: Botanic Gardens orchids, ArtScience Museum, evening Orchard Road Christmas lights.

itinerary.title: Jewel Changi, fly home
itinerary.plan: Early Jewel Rain Vortex waterfall, then fly home with 1 stop; land NYC Dec 20.

name: Ho Chi Minh City, Mekong + Phu Quoc, Vietnam
tagline: Saigon buzz, river markets, island beach
whyParents: French colonial Saigon meets floating markets and a warm beach finish, all at very low prices.

costPP.flightsBasis: Estimate. Cheapflights NYC-SGN average ~$967; Jetcost EWR-SGN from $1,120. No Dec 2026 quote found. Mid-Dec ~$1,200 plus ~$60 SGN/Can Tho-Phu Quoc domestic.
costPP.lodgingBasis: HCMC 3BR apartment ~$100/night x3, Can Tho 2 hotel rooms ~$60 x1, Phu Quoc villa ~$150/night x2; ~$660 split 4 ways
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$40/day food and sights, plus Mekong tour and $25 e-visa

flight.routing: JFK-HND-SGN on JAL; or Cathay JFK-HKG-SGN; or Qatar JFK-DOH-SGN
flight.notes: No US nonstop to Saigon. Return from Phu Quoc via SGN. Cathay Asia Miles and Avios (for Qatar) via Capital One.

weather.precip: dry season starts, rain ~5 days/month in HCMC; central Vietnam (Hoi An) is rainy and flood-prone in Dec, so skipped

stay: District 1 near Dong Khoi, walk to colonial sights.
getAround: Grab cars (7-seat for 4 + bags), private car to Mekong, short flight to Phu Quoc. Do not self-drive.
entry: E-visa required: $25, up to 90 days, apply at evisa.gov.vn ~1 week ahead.
events: No specific festival verified for Dec 12 to 18 2026; Christmas decorations line District 1 streets in mid-December (typical, not verified)
pros: Cheapest food and lodging in batch
Warm, mostly dry in the south

itinerary.eat: Banh mi at Banh Mi Huynh Hoa

name: Singapore + Bangkok combo
tagline: Two Asian capitals parents are curious about
whyParents: Covers both places that intrigue them: polished Singapore, then golden-temple Bangkok, linked by a 2h flight.

costPP.flightsBasis: Estimate. Open-jaw NYC-SIN, BKK-NYC ~$1,350 (SIN Dec fares ~$1,244, BKK ~$1,297 seen for other Dec dates) plus ~$80 SIN-BKK one-way.
costPP.lodgingBasis: Singapore 2 hotel rooms ~$500/night x3 plus Bangkok 3BR condo ~$120/night x3; ~$1,860 split 4 ways
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$50/day: pricier in Singapore, cheap in Bangkok

flight.routing: JFK-HND-SIN on JAL (AA codeshare) or JFK-HKG-SIN on Cathay, 1 stop. Singapore Airlines JFK/EWR-SIN nonstops have no economy cabin (premium economy and business only); SIN-BKK about 2h25m; home BKK-HND-JFK on JAL or BKK-HKG-JFK on Cathay
flight.notes: Book as multi-city. All-oneworld version: JAL via Tokyo both ways. KrisFlyer, Asia Miles, Avios transfer from Capital One.

weather.precip: Singapore: afternoon showers most days; Bangkok: dry season, rain rare

stay: Singapore: Marina Bay or Clarke Quay. Bangkok: Riverside, boats to temples.
getAround: Singapore MRT; Bangkok BTS, river boats, Grab XL cars for 4 + bags. No car rental.
entry: Both visa-free for US (SG 90 days, TH 30 days). File SG Arrival Card and Thai TDAC online, free.
events: Gardens by the Bay Christmas Wonderland: 2025 ran Nov 29 to Jan 1; 2026 dates not yet announced
Orchard Road Christmas lights: 2025 ran Nov 8 to Jan 1; 2026 dates not yet announced
